fix: Add a "Sitemap: https://yourdomain.com/sitemap.xml" directive to robots.txt.
Sitemap URL contains a fragment (#): "https://example.com/pricing#plans". Search engines index documents, not fragments. Remove the fragment.
Include Open Graph tags (<meta property="og:title"> and <meta property="og:description">) for social & AI citation sharing.
Invalid JSON inside <script type="application/ld+json">: Unexpected end of JSON input
Client-only SPA detected with empty root container and no pre-rendered content. Use SSG, SSR, or static prerendering so crawlers and AI assistants can extract content.
Add lang attribute to <html> tag (e.g. <html lang="en">).
Add a <meta name="description" content="..."> tag with 50–160 characters summarizing the page.
Page has 2 <h1> tags. Use exactly one <h1> for the page title and <h2>–<h6> for subsections.
Every must have an alt attribute (alt="" if decorative, or descriptive text).
Provide a visible <label for="...">, wrap input in <label>, or add aria-label for accessibility.
Avoid <a href="#">. Use a <button> for clickable actions or provide a meaningful href URL.
